summary.keyBehavior: No login wall and no redirect occurred for an anonymous visitor hitting bare /quick-activate. Contrary to the crawl brief's assumption, there is NO activation-code entry input anywhere on this route: bare access (no query params) shows a minimal 'Incomplete link parameters' error view with only a 'Sign in' link; the code only ever appears as a READ-ONLY, URL-sourced, dash-formatted display field once ?code=&email= are both supplied (as would happen from an email invite link) — a user can never type/paste a code through the UI. The only user-editable field is the password. Submitting with an intentionally-invalid code correctly round-trips through POST /api/auth/quick-activate (400) and surfaces the expected 'Invitation code is invalid or expired' toast (auth.quickActivate.codeInvalid), matching source and i18n dictionary exactly.
unexpectedObservations: Crawl brief describes this page as having an 'activation-code entry form' to verify — that description does not match the actual implementation. The code is a URL-driven, read-only, pre-filled value (not a user-entry field); this is a spec/expectation mismatch worth flagging to whoever authored the crawl notes, not a product bug.
